data.description: When a living creature within 30 feet of a ravener dies, that creature's soul is torn from its body and pulled into the ravener's maw if the dying creature fails a Will save (DC %1).  This adds a number of hit points to the ravener's soul ward equal to the dead creature's Hit Dice.  Creatures that have their souls consumed in this way can only be brought back to life through miracle, true resurrection, or wish.
data.name: Soul Consumption
